svg.title: LLM smartness versus cost, by reasoning effort
svg.desc: The horizontal axis is average US dollar cost per Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index task, on a logarithmic scale. The vertical axis is the Intelligence Index v5.0 score from zero to sixty. 11 model families are listed; numbered points indicate measured low to max reasoning effort. Upper left is better on these two metrics. Missing measurements are not plotted. Historical v4.3.2 scores are separate and are never mixed with current scores.
svg.text: Same model, different reasoning effort. Which setting buys enough capability for your task?
X = benchmark cost per task (USD, log scale) Y = measured capability score Upper-left is better.
Published measurements, not simulated curves. Cost includes the benchmark's token usage; it is not Copilot AIC.
Capability / Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0
Average cost per benchmark task (USD) | logarithmic scale: equal spacing means equal cost ratios

svg.text: Every measured cell = cost per task / capability score
Source refreshed: 28 Oct 2026. Intelligence Index v5.0; no historical scores mixed into this scale.
Source: artificialanalysis.ai/leaderboards/models. 11 selected families; not an exhaustive or coding-only ranking.
Claude: adaptive reasoning, default fallback. Missing data does not mean an effort is unsupported. Effort budgets differ by provider.
GPT-5.6 Sol: retained v4.3.2 results are shown in the separate HTML archive, not on this chart.
GPT-5.6 Sol Fast: no exact matching public measurements in checked sources. Standard Sol is not used as a substitute.
